nodes.label: allowBuilds install-script allow-list
nodes.rationale: Allows prisma, @prisma/engines, @swc/core; denies @scarf/scarf analytics and optional msgpackr-extract.

nodes.label: Native ESM everywhere
nodes.rationale: NestJS 12 ships ESM-only.

nodes.label: Version pins (TS 6.0.3, Next 16.3.8, Prisma 7.10.0, ESLint 9.39.5, NestJS 12, Zod 4.6.5)
nodes.norm_label: version pins (ts 6.0.3, next 16.3.8, prisma 7.10.0, eslint 9.39.5, nestjs 12, zod 4.6.5)
nodes.rationale: Avoid TS 7, ESLint 10, Prisma 8 RC until ecosystems catch up; Next 16.4.0 blocked by release-age policy which is kept rather than bypassed.

nodes.label: Vitest single test runner
nodes.rationale: One runner across ESM packages, Nest (unplugin-swc) and Next; Supertest for HTTP; Playwright for browser.

nodes.label: ADR-0001: pnpm workspaces + Turborepo monorepo
nodes.rationale: Three apps (web, API, worker) share schemas, Prisma client, queue names, layouts; small team with cross-cutting changes. Separate repos cause contract drift; Nx too heavy.

nodes.label: ADR-0004: S3-compatible object storage (MinIO local, R2/S3 prod)
nodes.norm_label: adr-0004: s3-compatible object storage (minio local, r2/s3 prod)

nodes.label: ADR-0005: Toolchain baseline and version pins
nodes.norm_label: adr-0005: toolchain baseline and version pins
nodes.rationale: Several 'latest' tags were RCs or unsupported majors on 7 Oct 2026; pins chosen for ecosystem compatibility.

nodes.label: API enqueues heavy jobs to worker via Redis
nodes.norm_label: api enqueues heavy jobs to worker via redis
nodes.rationale: Excel import, PDF rendering, bulk issuance are slow; ADR-0003.

nodes.label: minimumReleaseAge supply-chain gate
nodes.rationale: Holds back very recently published versions to reduce supply-chain risk.

nodes.label: Private buckets with short-lived presigned URLs
nodes.norm_label: private buckets with short-lived presigned urls
nodes.rationale: Files served only after authorization check; least-privilege app user; no public ACLs.
